scope: resource accounting only; no physical or solver criterion change
measurements: actual accepted-step exclusive CPU, native nonstep startup/output CPU, four physical controls plus constitutive audit CPU, controller CPU, native versus fixed audit output bytes; record zero-step startup separately
CPU: 1.25*(max accepted-step CPU*remaining pair steps + max native nonstep CPU*remaining segments + 4*(observed pair audit CPU + observed controller CPU))
storage: 1.25*(max native bytes per accepted step*remaining pair steps + 4*observed pair audit bytes)
interpretation: conservative measured finite campaign estimate; audits are fixed per milestone, not governing solves or per-step work. Resource admission is separate from physical-pair qualification. Do not claim active-wall admission from CPU alone; report suspensions and measured wall/CPU ratio and close outer receipts before continuation.
